items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: First we had Budd Johnson on tenor, and then we switched over and got Rudy Williams. It was a good band.

ctx.x: Well, that was an interesting trip, which the Institute is very interested in. Of course, you and I have talked about this story before, but I think we should go into it in some detail. It was a USO tour.

Yeah. Well, Oscar had met this doctor from Orange, New Jersey or somewhere, and they had talked him into getting a six-piece group together so that we could play the USO camps -- which he did. We all got together. First we had Budd Johnson on tenor, and then we switched over and got Rudy Williams. It was a good band.
